notes.title: Melee combat and new scenery
notes.content:
[h2]Reinvented combat[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771589/cd36510f58f27d6b27d8b10076fcf3974f47aa1c.gif[/img]
The main aim of this update was to make combat more engaging. With more interaction between you and your enemies, who will behave in unexpected ways.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771589/c2768ecafc9c700315bf0c79d28c756165716434.gif[/img]
To do this, we've added weapons and shields so you can fight your enemies in a melee, play with the distance between you and them, and recharge your mana once you've killed them.


[h2]Improved scenery quality, Immersion++[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771589/3a697411d836925c1a3b4ccc6df2d7d8e326c4cd.png[/img]

notes.title: Radical changes in the way you travel.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771589/ece437feea613ba71ddaaacb9baa72fb9839e76d.png[/img]

A new way of traveling is introduced in Spellz, making the game much more seamless and highlighting various gameplay mechanics using the new 'travel altars.' Let's see what's new.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771589/5c72f8d13337c4368fdb03f5716433e84a74be21.png[/img]
[list][*]Let's get straight to the point. If you've ever played Spellz, you'll know that Achievements are one of the game's core mechanics. For beginners, this is what rewards you for completing a level in record time, without getting hit. The new movement system places ENORMOUS emphasis on this by suggesting restarting the level to achieve these objectives. The result is an incredibly smooth experience.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771589/9ea5ff93bab3d89d5d023e6dae14b64262ebec34.png[/img]
[list]
[*] With time, we realized that players were forgetting to visit the Merchant's Tavern. Yet, that's where you can buy everything! (runes, spells, health potions...) With this new update, it's sorted. There's a travel altar at the beginning of each level that allows you to go there. It's a significant change for Spellz, believe me.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771589/cd78c16e7e6effec9c2e0cfb651a44ffbd5c5fc8.png[/img]
And to wrap it up, we've added the altar that takes you to the world map. It's from there that you can navigate between levels.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
Travel altars are now present in a few different locations:
[list]
[*] The tavern, retry, and the world map in the achievements room.
[*] The tavern and the world map at the beginning of each level.
[/list]

There will be significant changes around these altars, mainly focusing on their visual appeal and user enjoyment. I'll keep you updated.

Feel free to contact me to share your thoughts!
[url=https://twitter.com/tom_creepycraft style=button]My Twitter/X[/url]

Until next time,
Tom.

notes.title: We have never been so close to the "end".
notes.content:
The last few months of intensive work have not been in vain.
Spellz is getting closer and closer to its final form.

[h2]A new world map (major update):[/h2]
[list]
[*]23 islands instead of 9.
[*]Removal of the 'difficulty' system per map. 
[*]Changes to navigation, for a smoother, more enjoyable experience.
[*]Removal of the 'Tavern' from the map, which can now be accessed directly from the teleportation portal.
[*]New maps are displayed in green on the map.
[*]A completion percentage for the entire game has been displayed on the map, with the length of the game underneath (all written with bones, of course).
[/list] 

[h3]Additional changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Integration of stereo audio.
[*]New "Molten Rain" spell unlocked at the end of the first level.
[*]Some changes to the Tavern environment to make it more understandable.
[*]Removal of the timer in the shop, now you just have to buy all the items or pay to refresh it.
[*]Some adjustments to the difficulty.
[*]A few bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]I need YOU:[/h3]
To succeed in creating the best game for our future players, I'll need you to share your experience of Spellz, mainly around difficulty. That would be the best way of fine-tuning the game, so thanks in advance!

Thank you for reading these notes, I hope everything's going well for you and I can't wait to hear your feedback on this update!

See you soon,
Tom.
